description.zh: 磁通量、法拉第定律、楞次定律与转动线圈发电；偶极子近似的教学模型，不含自感与电阻。
description.en: Flux, Faraday's law, Lenz's law and a spinning-coil generator in a dipole-approximation teaching model without self-inductance or resistance.

label.zh: 电压是磁通量的变化率
label.en: Voltage is the rate of change of flux

reason.zh: ε = −N dΦ/dt 直接是磁通量对时间的导数。
reason.en: ε = −N dΦ/dt is literally the time derivative of the flux.

label.en: A spinning coil gives a sine

reason.zh: 匀速转动使磁通量按余弦变化，感应电动势是同频率的正弦波。
reason.en: Uniform rotation makes the flux a cosine, so the emf is a sine at the same frequency.

reason.zh: 静止电荷的电场有势；变化磁场产生的电动势则沿回路绕圈。
reason.en: Electrostatic fields have a potential; the emf from a changing magnetic field circulates around the loop.

title.zh: 变化的磁场怎样变成电压？
title.en: How does a changing magnetic field become a voltage?
